installer.notice.title: FaceLogin 2.0.0 Release Notes
installer.notice.body:
Recognition and camera:
SCRFD, 106 landmarks, 512-D embeddings, 112x112 RGB input, and users.dat V5 are retained; the service and Console use Media Foundation first with DirectShow fallback, while experimental software photometric normalization, hardware exposure control, and low-light enhancement settings have been removed
Head-pose detection:
Added a MobileNetV2 head-pose model; lock-screen recognition uses Yaw, Pitch, and Roll to provide direction-specific guidance
Pose guidance is localized for Simplified Chinese, Korean, and English, with direction-specific guidance shown for the detected pose
Authentication and lock-screen interaction:
Mouse-movement false triggers are filtered; only keyboard keys and mouse buttons can actively start ordinary unlock recognition
Cold boot starts recognition automatically by default and can be configured to wait for a key or mouse button; authentication status is shown in a central secure-desktop overlay
Anti-Spoof binds identity matching and liveness inference to the same candidate account; Blink keeps a post-blink match confirmation, while none skips liveness
After a timeout or no-match result, the next valid keyboard or mouse-button input can start a fresh recognition attempt
Console and installer:
Console now has single-instance protection, custom face-management dialogs, and high-DPI support; installer confirmations use the same custom dialog style
The installer adds a lightweight standalone Uninstall.exe, install-path validation, and an optional desktop shortcut; installation runs without showing a console window
Compatibility and packaging:
Current V5/ONNX templates do not require re-enrollment for this migration; each account can store up to 10 faces
The pose model and license are included, and unused image dependencies and the diagnostic program have been removed
